steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ using username admin and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}; verify that the authenticated CRM page is open.
02-open: In EspoCRM, open the Opportunities list and report the names of every opportunity whose name starts exactly with Seed:, preserving the displayed names. Do not edit any records.

03-create: Create a new EspoCRM opportunity named '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', linked to the account 'Bench Account' by selecting the actual matching record from suggestions or the select dialog, and set its description to include '{{runid}}'. Save it and verify the created opportunity shows that exact name, linked account, and description.
04-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and set its stage to Negotiation. Save, then verify the detail page displays Stage = Negotiation.

05-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' to set Amount to 12500 in the default currency and Close Date to 2026-12-31. Save, then verify both values on the saved record's detail page.

06-edit: Edit the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' and assign it to user 'Bench Assignee' by choosing the actual matching user record from suggestions or the select dialog, not just typing. Save and verify the saved detail page shows assigned user Bench Assignee.

07-create: On the Stream of the existing opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity', create a post whose text includes the exact runid '{{runid}}'. Submit it and verify the Stream displays the posted text.
persistence: re-read what the flow saved
